intro.title: Dynamics / CRM data visualization customization
intro.subtitle: Dynamics holds everything about your clients and projects, but it does not always show what managers need to see every day.
intro.desc: We build a visualization layer on top of your Dynamics 365 / CRM and financial system data, so your team can follow clients, projects and results in tailored dashboards, without switching between screens or exporting spreadsheets. Every dashboard is designed around the decisions your company needs to make.

faq.title: Before you get in touch, you may want to know:

items.q: Do I need to switch CRMs to use this customization?
items.a: No. The solution connects to the Dynamics your company already uses: it organizes and presents the data and does not replace the CRM.
Client, account, opportunity and project data from Dynamics, combined with financial data such as revenue, costs and margin. We define with you which indicators make sense for each area.

We start by understanding which decisions your management needs to make and which data lives in Dynamics and in the financial systems. Then we design the views, validate them with you and evolve in stages.

items.q: Does WA Coders do the customization for my company?
items.a: Yes. Each dashboard is designed and built to fit your operation, with your branding and your business rules.
